facts.clause: If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them.

Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.
The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.
Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance.
Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed.
